key_insight: IANN unifies seven equivariant interatomic neural network architectures in one PyTorch framework, making architecture selection a one-word configuration change.
engineering_relevance: A shared training and deployment workflow reduces re-engineering when comparing interatomic potentials or moving them into ASE and LAMMPS simulations.
method: Standardize atomic data, training and deployment across PaiNN, NequIP, MACE, Allegro, EquiformerV2, EquiformerV3 and UMA.
Derive forces, stresses and virials through analytic energy differentiation with respect to graph edge vectors, including periodic boundaries.
Automatically configure distributed training and deploy self-describing checkpoints through ASE or TorchScript-enabled LAMMPS interfaces.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports architecture comparisons on a common dataset of millions of structures and released PaiNN foundation models trained on 41.9 million curated DFT structures spanning PBE, RPBE and r2SCAN.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical accuracy or speed benchmarks, so performance and deployment efficiency require validation for the target simulation.
paper_title: IANN: A Unified Framework for Equivariant InterAtomic Neural Networks with User-Friendly Implementation
